videos.title: The sleekest wallet yet?
videos.description:
The sleekest wallet yet? Today we're toying with the OhSnap Snap Wallet 2, a lever-action aluminum wallet you can customize and transform. You can make it thicker to hold more cards, add double-sided magnets to attach to your phone, add ID badges and much more. It's pricy (starting at $60) and can get thick and heavy if you stack too much, but the 3-card version is sleek, the mechanism is neat, and it's easy to reconfigure! It's on Kickstarter now with a slight discount.
